name: ats-job-scraper-direct-from-career-sites
title: ATS Job Scraper - Direct from Career Sites
description: Fresh job postings pulled straight from employers' own career sites across 10 ATS platforms including Greenhouse, Workday, Ashby, Lever and Personio. No aggregator duplicates, no recruiter reposts, no dead apply links. One normalised schema with parsed salary, location, seniority and work arrangement. Expired jobs detected at no extra cost.
